source: Binance Data Vision (USD-M futures, public) and the Binance USD-M Futures REST API
howToVerify: Download each zip_url and its checksum_url.
sha256 of the zip must equal zip_sha256_official (the value in Binance's .CHECKSUM file).
Extract the single CSV from the zip without modification; its sha256 must equal csv_sha256.

csv_matches_local_input_csv: the extracted CSV is byte-identical to the local CSV prepared for the run. The BTC engine read these CSVs directly; their hashes, and those of all 1m klines and markPriceKlines CSVs, are also recorded in the frozen execution plan (csv_matches_frozen_hash).

ETH aggTrades: the ETH engine read compressed tick files converted from these CSVs before the freeze. The frozen execution plan records the hashes of the converted files, not of the CSVs. The conversion code is not published.

funding.note: Funding rows were retrieved from the API on 2026-10-05 and normalized to JSON; the JSON is not published. Re-query the API to compare rows.
